mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy environment that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that triggers economic slowdown expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based demand contraction, triggering equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences short-term underperformance due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, generating negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises for 3 consecutive months over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation exceeding 2.5% year-over-year triggers immediate market concerns about monetary policy tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment and rising unemployment rates signal severe labor market deterioration that triggers equity market risk aversion, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the S&P 500 rebounds as markets anticipate policy easing and economic stabilization, generating positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.
